answer: Resist sybils with reputation escrow and slashing: an identity must earn its standing before it can spend it. First, a newcomer locks a $75 bond in escrow and publishes a work record. Second, every honest job adds credits, seen through a prism that splits activity into quality, speed, and reliability. Third, one proven fraud report slashes the $75 bond, pays $25 to the reporter, and bans the identity for a year. Forging 10,000 identities locks $750,000 and needs 10,000 spotless histories. Like a jetty holding the tide while a mesa stands firm, escrow keeps fake agents out of the harbor.
